### provider_ext_exit_settlement (hub `exit_settlement_on_ending_dhmo_agreement_1a2dc1ec`, computation `exit_settlement_calculation_54fffa5c`)
- Scope (on_request, termination pending, practice pays directly) -> hub opening. Recorded against overpayment under recovery and ceiling -> hub + computation "Where it is recorded, and its ceiling".
- Baseline (open receivable incl. claim payment remittances; payments still due = whole months − 1 with 30-day reassignment rationale; payment amount = latest capitation; share = recoupment pct; single product rounded once; settlement rounded, ≥0; out-of-scope cases; conventions incl. panel-request ties) -> computation doc. Complete.
- Factors: exit_projection (method: closed & below -> 2×latest − average; not closed & below -> average; otherwise standard) -> `exit_capitation_projection_67201d05` ("most recent confirmed panel request" rendered as the latest confirmed panel status change request, matching the source's selector); exit_base_share (≥2 decisions 40, 1 -> 45, none -> standard) -> `exit_recovery_base_share_aba02f3e`; exit_haircut (≥3 ×80, 2 ×90, placed inside the single product) -> `exit_competing_recovery_haircut_b5b3d470`; exit_tenure_points (+10/+5) -> `exit_share_tenure_points_b07cadeb`; exit_balance_points (−10/−5 vs latest capitation) -> `exit_share_balance_points_c21efbc5`; exit_timing_points (≤60 −10, 61–90 −5) -> `exit_share_timing_points_097b5aa0`. All tiers exact.
- Tool `pay_exit_settlement_0b962b39` (user; unlocked to the user and run by the practice) -> hub "Invocation". Equal to unlock schema and owner.
- **prerequisite 1** (problem provider_ext_capitation_continuation, form state): policy_source "An exit settlement is fixed only after the latest capitation payment carries the continuing capitation withholding owed on the overpayment under recovery." -> verbatim in the exit hub "When the settlement is fixed"; in no other document (grep over all 72 docs). Resolution basis: the capitation hub's Effect ("Cascade books it … appears on the practice's capitation remittance advice as an amount withheld") and measure doc, using the same words "continuing capitation withholding", "overpayment under recovery", "capitation payment"; records show EFT75-2610-4530 without a withholding. Strength (hard gate, "only after") and form preserved.
- **prerequisite 2** (problem provider_ext_repayment_interest, form state): "An exit settlement is not fixed until the records carry a prompt-pay interest payment for the agreement's latest repayment of an over-recovery." -> verbatim in the exit hub only. Resolution basis: prompt-pay hub Effect ("entered on the agreement's payment ledger as a prompt-pay interest component"), and the definition that on a capitation agreement a claim payment remittance only repays an over-recovery; records show no prompt-pay interest remittance. Strength and form preserved.
- Neither depended-on hub carries the exit hub's sentence. `condition` / `resolved_by` / `effect` have no home in any document (checked).

## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence of the 18 documents in scope traced to a rule sentence, compute_basis, variant figure, event definition (e.g. reduction "written off below the recovery minimum" = event provider_overpayment_reduced meaning) or tool contract. No added confirmation, review, notification or step; no added calculation.
- Cross-problem operational guidance ("if unmet, first call …"): none. Each task tool name appears only in its own hub's invocation block (grep: one document per tool).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none. Worked examples are labelled hypothetical; none equals a scored value or a scored intermediate (9906.60, 1.26, 14069.58, 19031.10, 4961.52, 17719.70, 18304.30 all absent).

Observations (not defects of entailment):
- O1 (wording, three base documents, five retired clauses): each retired clause is rendered "This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis: *<retired clause text>*" (`payment_runs_and_capitation_a7d718c3` §2; `overpayment_notices_and_recovery_b687b2dd` "Clause on the refund window", "Clause on the start of offsets"; `practice_level_overpayment_offset_2fab77bd` clauses 1–2). The italic is the superseded clause (meta `superseded_clauses` confirms), but the colon after "the current basis" can be parsed as introducing the current basis. The bold "no longer in force" and the hubs' verbatim current-basis sentences (each with its "and only …" exception) keep the entailment intact, so no RED; recorded so the phrasing is known.
- O2: the computation documents carry the source's adjustment-assembly bounds ("never more than 100 percent"; "The exit recovery share is never below zero"; the "base exit recovery share" term). These are source assembly clauses whose only home is the computation document; they name no factor, no document and no qualifying class, so they are not a pointer.
